UP-Term-git: parts, licences and where the source is

Part                          Licence                          Source
----------------------------  -------------------------------  --------------------------------------------
git 2.56.0 and its templates (bin/git, bin/git-*, share/git-core) GPL v2 only (COPYING, LGPL-2.1 for its libraries) upterm-ports (pkgs/git; git-2.56.0.tar.xz)

Notes
- These files were part of UP-Term.lha until the slim base (P9); the package installs them at the
  same paths in UP-Term:. Its row of SOURCES.txt is in UP-Term:licenses/git/SOURCES.txt.
- The complete source with UP-Term's patches and build recipes is UP-Term-src.lha, published next to
  UP-Term.lha.
